payload.blocks: Phase 6 of plan 261122-2108 (branch delete-dead-node-execution-closure/p06, tip 74244f5ce, reviewed), and through it phases 8, 11 and 10; every other land may hit the same refusal.
payload.headline: Clear an abandoned Land of a dead writer so plan 2108 phase 6 can land

parts.cause: `fgos git recover` settles a chain only for the writer that started it, and the writer is dead. The supervisor's confinement cannot run git recovery at all (git-floor-probe-failed: read-only file system).

options.does: Owner runs in /home/vantt/projects/forgent: fgos git status; fgos git recover. If the abandoned Land is still pending afterwards, that is a land-door defect: say so in the answer and the supervisor files a backlog row.
options.gain: Unblocks phase 6 and any other land the stale chain blocks.
options.harm: None known; recover never deletes worktrees, locks or refs.
options.label: Run the recovery yourself

options.does: Nothing runs; phase 6 stays parked in the plan.
options.harm: Plan 2108 cannot finish; other lands may keep failing on the same chain.
options.label: Leave phase 6 parked

parts.recommendation: Run the recovery yourself; then the supervisor wakes the 2108 lead to retry the land.

scope.allows: fgos git status and fgos git recover in the main checkout, and the lead retrying the phase 6 land.
scope.forbids: Hand deletion of refs, journal files or worktrees, and any forced land.

parts.what: The 2108 lead's `fgos land` of phase 6 (ticket c-46094-1795595969494) was refused land-abandoned-writer-mismatch. `fgos git status` shows a pending Land land-6918-1795595931515632458-1 started at 08:38:51Z by writer 6829; no process 6829 exists, so that Land is abandoned.
